test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

He behaves so aggressive in his new/ home that he is rehoused with an old/ couple who could give him everything he lacks.

options.text: couple who could give him everything he lacks.
home that he is rehoused with an old
He behaves so aggressive in his new

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **error** in the sentence is the** inappropriate use of the adjective** 'aggressive'. 
 
• **Adjectives** modify or describe nouns, they do not describe verbs or actions. However, in this sentence 'aggressive' is wrongly used to describe the verb 'behaves'.
 
• The **correction requires** an **adverb** form to denote how the action (behaves) is performed. The appropriate adverb form of aggressive is 'aggressively'.

Therefore, the **corrected sentence** is: *"He behaves so aggressively in his new home that he is rehoused with an old couple who could give him everything he lacks."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In **'Option 1',** "couple who could give him everything he lacks" is correctly used in the context of the sentence. The phrase explains what the old couple can do for the subject of the sentence.
 
• In **'Option 2', **"home that he is rehoused with an old" is a fragment of the original sentence and it contains no grammatical error.
 
• **'Option 3'** suggests that there was 'No error' which is incorrect because the use of 'aggressive' in the sentence was not grammatically correct. Generally, when the verb 'behave' is used with an adverb it should be in the '-ly' form which suggests the manner of the behavior.
